newsitem.title: USA: Comstock files for 5.9 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Comstock files for 5.9 million shares.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 5,870,000 common shares.
Of the total, four million common shares are being offered by the company and 1,870,000 million common are being sold by certain shareholders, the filing said.
Comstock granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 880,000 additional common shares. After the offering, the outstanding shares will total 23,106,806 common, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Raymond James & Associates Inc, Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Oppenheimer & Co Inc and Rodman & Renshaw Inc.
The Dallas, Texaas company will use the proceeds to reduce outstanding indebtedness under the company's Bank Credit Facility.
Comstock is an independent energy company engaged in the acquisition, development, production and exploration of oil and natural gas properties.
